title: A Cascaded Unsupervised-Supervised NLP Pipeline for Detecting Accusatory Language in Public Procurement
abstract: arXiv:2608.12269v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Public procurement involves the allocation of substantial financial resources; therefore, continuous oversight through audits, controls, and monitoring mechanisms is essential. However, stakeholder comments and publicly available government data are often underutilized, despite their potential to reveal procedural irregularities. To address this gap, this paper analyzes metadata from Ecuador's Sistema Oficial de Contrataci\'on P\'ublica (SOCE, Official Public Procurement System), with particular emphasis on participant comments generated during the pre-contractual phase. We propose a hybrid modeling framework that integrates unsupervised clustering and supervised classification within a natural language processing (NLP) pipeline to uncover latent patterns and detect potentially irregular procurement processes. translated_title: 一种用于检测公共采购中指控性语言的级联无监督-有监督NLP管道
translated_abstract: 公共采购涉及大量财政资源的分配；因此，通过审计、控制和监测机制进行持续监督至关重要。然而，利益相关者的评论和公开可用的政府数据往往未得到充分利用，尽管它们可能揭示程序性违规行为。为解决这一差距，本文分析了厄瓜多尔官方公共采购系统（SOCE）的元数据，特别强调合同前阶段产生的参与者评论。我们提出了一种混合建模框架，该框架在自然语言处理（NLP）管道中集成了无监督聚类和有监督分类，以揭示潜在模式并检测可能不规范的采购流程。语义嵌入使用Word2Vec、LLaMA和RoBERTa生成，随后采用高斯混合模型（GMM）进行无监督分析。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合无监督聚类与有监督分类的级联NLP管道，通过分析厄瓜多尔公共采购系统中的参与者评论，有效检测潜在的采购违规行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a cascaded NLP pipeline combining unsupervised clustering and supervised classification to analyze participant comments in Ecuador's public procurement system, effectively detecting potential procurement irregularities.
